findings.quote: Many people ask, "Can my teeth be this bad off after a six-month checkup?"
findings.why: The "many people ask" framing is an unsupported statistic-style claim with no source, and it reads like a generic AI-written hook.
findings.fix: Remove the "many people ask" framing and state the point directly, e.g. "A cavity can be small and hard to detect at one visit."

findings.quote: Many patients also ask whether they can see the same dentist for the checkup and the cavity treatment.
findings.why: The frequency of patient questions is not in the ficha or any cited source, so the claim is unverified.
findings.fix: Delete the sentence or rephrase it as a practical instruction, e.g. "You can ask us to book the checkup and treatment with the same dentist."
